meta.subject: Stall for WAWs between load instructions

en.summary: ROB hazard detection was fixed to stall write-after-write conflicts between load instructions because load responses can return out of order.
why_it_counts: Patch changes ROB dependency logic in core RTL
The commit message explains a concrete correctness bug from out-of-order load responses
The new condition specifically extends WAW detection to load-queue entries
evidence: ROB.scala changes the WAW predicate from `e.bits.q =/= new_entry.q` to `(e.bits.q =/= new_entry.q || new_entry.q === ldq)`
The surrounding code checks overlapping destination regions in scratchpad or accumulator space
The commit message states TileLink loads can respond out of order

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: If a memory subsystem can return load responses out of order, then two in-flight loads that write the same local destination region must still be treated as a write-after-write hazard even if they originate from the same queue class. Otherwise the older response can arrive late and overwrite data produced by the younger load.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: Multiple load instructions target overlapping scratchpad or accumulator regions and their memory responses are allowed to complete out of order.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Exempt same-queue load instructions from WAW hazard checks so they can issue concurrently.
portability_notes: Apply this to any ROB, reservation station, or scoreboard that reasons about destination overlap.
The key bug is not general queue ordering; it is assuming the load pipeline preserves write order when the memory fabric does not.
Another DUT may name the load queue differently, but the reinjection point is the WAW predicate for memory-writing loads.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the hazard predicate that blocks a new memory load when an older in-flight operation writes an overlapping destination.
Remove the special case that treats overlapping loads as a WAW conflict even when they are from the same load queue.
Leave the address-overlap test intact so only the missing load-to-load hazard protection is reintroduced.
Drive two overlapping loads whose responses can return in the opposite order.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ROB WAW conflict predicate for ldq entries
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix adds || new_entry.q === ldq to the WAW check so overlapping loads are stalled even when both entries are in the load queue.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Delete the || new_entry.q === ldq term from the waws predicate in ROB.scala while keeping the overlap checks unchanged.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Overlapping loads can issue without proper serialization, letting an older response arrive late and overwrite newer data in scratchpad or accumulator state.
evidence_for_injection: The commit message ties the bug directly to out-of-order TileLink responses.
The code change is inside the WAW hazard predicate rather than a general performance heuristic.
The destination-overlap checks already existed, so the fix only restores the missing load-specific stall rule.
notes: This mutation is most visible when the memory system can reorder or delay load completions.
It is a clean reverse patch with minimal collateral behavior change.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 ROB 的相关性检测，使其在加载指令之间也会对写后写冲突进行停顿，因为加载响应可能乱序返回。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改了核心 RTL 中 ROB 的依赖检测逻辑
提交信息明确说明了由加载响应乱序返回引起的正确性问题
新增条件专门将 WAW 检测扩展到了 load queue 条目
evidence: ROB.scala 将 WAW 判断条件从 `e.bits.q =/= new_entry.q` 改为 `(e.bits.q =/= new_entry.q || new_entry.q === ldq)`
周围代码检查的是 scratchpad 或 accumulator 目标区域是否重叠
提交信息指出 TileLink 加载可能乱序响应

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 如果内存子系统允许 load 响应乱序返回，那么两个写入同一本地目标区域的在途 load，即使都来自同一个 load 队列，也必须被当成写后写冲突处理。否则较早的响应可能在较晚时刻返回，并覆盖掉较新的 load 已经写入的数据。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: load 对 load 的 WAW 冲突检测
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 多个 load 指令指向重叠的 scratchpad 或 accumulator 区域，且内存响应允许乱序完成。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让同一队列中的 load 指令免于 WAW 冲突检查，从而允许它们并发发射。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 删除同队列 load 冲突项
portability_notes: 可应用到任何基于 ROB、reservation station 或 scoreboard 的目标地址重叠检测逻辑。
关键缺陷并不是一般的队列顺序，而是错误地假设 load 流水线天然保持写回顺序。
其他 DUT 也许不会把 load queue 命名为 ldq，但回注点仍然是针对会写本地状态的内存 load 的 WAW 谓词。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位在有旧在途操作写重叠目标时阻止新 load 进入的 hazard 谓词。
删除“即使同属 load 队列也要视为 WAW 冲突”的特殊情况。
保留地址重叠判断不变，只重现“缺失 load 对 load 保护”这一缺陷。
驱动两个写入重叠区域、且响应可能反向返回的 load。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: ROB 中针对 ldq 条目的 WAW 冲突谓词
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复在 WAW 检查中加入了 || new_entry.q === ldq，使重叠 load 即使都在 load queue 中也会被停顿。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 ROB.scala 的 waws 谓词中删除 || new_entry.q === ldq，同时保持重叠判断不变。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 目标重叠的 load 可以在没有正确串行化的情况下发射，导致较早的响应晚到并覆盖 scratchpad 或 accumulator 中较新的数据。
evidence_for_injection: 提交信息把 bug 直接归因于 TileLink 响应乱序。
代码修改发生在 WAW 冲突谓词内部，而不是一般的性能启发式逻辑。
目标重叠判断本来就存在，因此这次修复只是补上了缺失的 load 专属停顿规则。
notes: 当内存系统能够重排或延迟 load 完成时，这个变异最容易暴露。
这是一个非常干净的逆向补丁，附带行为变化很小。
